$comment: Part I Section B — contracting authority (buyer). The identity of the procurer. Hand-authored (not compiler-generated): Part I is administrative data, not a criterion. The field set matches the Schematron-mandated minimum (BR-REQ-20-02..04): official name (fatal), country (fatal), identifier (warning). Address/contact/URIs are optional in the Schematron and omitted here.
title: ESPD Part I Section B — Contracting Authority

contractingAuthority.description: Identity of the procurer (PI02). Maps to cac:ContractingParty/cac:Party.

officialName.description: Official name of the contracting authority or contracting entity. Mandatory (BR-REQ-20-02, fatal). Maps to cac:PartyName/cbc:Name.

country.description: Country of the contracting authority, as a Country codelist code. Mandatory (BR-REQ-20-03, fatal). Maps to cac:PostalAddress/cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode. The 341 codes from Country.gc are validated by the test (too many to inline as an enum); the CVA validates the value at the XML layer.

partyIdentifier.description: A structured party identifier carrying both the value and the scheme it belongs to. Maps to cac:PartyIdentification/cbc:ID (value) with @schemeID (scheme). The Schematron recommends at least one identifier (BR-REQ-20-04, warning) but does not make it fatal.

value.description: The identifier value (e.g. 'B82387770'). Maps to the text content of cbc:ID.

scheme.description: The identifier scheme from EOIDType.gc. Maps to @schemeID on cbc:ID. The CVA (01-ESPD-codelist-values) validates this value against EOIDType.gc (case-insensitive).
